outline: 冷凍設計、庫體設計、保溫與防漏設計、熱負荷計算、溫濕度控制、除霜設計與控制、氣流設計、性能分析
schedule:
1 Introduction
2 Basis of food technology
3 Food microbiology and refrigeration
4 Thermal properties of foods
5 Chilling and Freezing time of food
6 Commodity storage requirements
7 Design and operation of cold stores
8 Types of operation and construction of cold stores
9 Principles of cold stores design (refrigeration load calculation)
10 Refrigeration plant and equipments
11 Controlled atmosphere storage (alternative atmosphere storage, oxygen, carbon dioxide, ethylene removal, instrumentation, safety)
12 Fully automated cold stores
13 Design of land and sea transport refrigeration
14 Marine refrigeration
15 Trucks, trailers, and containers
16 Railroad refrigerator cars
assessment:
1. Homework 40%
2. Mid-term exam or Design project 30%
3. Final report 30%
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

1. ASHRAE, 2010 Refrigeration Handbook
2. IIR, Cold Store Guide, 3rd, 1993
